versions.name: Hills and Hollows
versions.summary: A small Longhorn Council weekend campground on wooded acreage in Denton, Texas, north of the Dallas-Fort Worth area, with hillside campsites, a fire pit, and a large pavilion for unit camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Longhorn Council Hills and Hollows page, which confirms it as an active, council-accessible (privately owned) 25-acre weekend campground in Denton. The source's 'Decatur' city label is wrong; the camp is in Denton. Coordinates geocoded via US Census from the scout-camp-map street address; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active status verified against the council page; city corrected from Decatur to Denton. Privately owned property reserved through the council; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend-camping property; features unsurveyed.
